body.text: This continues #4791, which I took over from its original author. Their three commits are kept as they wrote them. Closes #4693. **Markdown editor for pull comments.** New pull comments use the shared markdown editor. It gets a toolbar that appears when you select text (bold, italic, strikethrough, code, links, lists and quotes), slash commands, and the typeahead keeps the highlighted suggestion in view. **A simpler comment form.** The bottom row now has, from left to right: - Preview, as a toggle button - Attach images - Pin to the current commit, as a toggle button (it replaces the checkbox in a separate card) - A square send button with an arrow. Its tooltip shows the action and the shortcut (⌘/Ctrl + Enter). The toggles turn indigo with a filled icon when they're on. To keep that readable in dark mode, the dark info background colors are a little lighter. **Wrap in the diff toolbar** is now a toggle button that matches the others, instead of a switch. **Tooltips fade out where they are.** Before, Firefox could make a tooltip jump sideways or up while it faded out. | | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Empty | | | | With text | | | | Pinned to a commit | | | | Send tooltip | — | | | Selection toolbar | | | | Slash commands | | | | Wrap off | | | | Wrap on | | | Part 2 of 4, stacked on the first: 1. #4812 hide pull actions from signed-out viewers 2. #4813 markdown editor and comment form (this one) 3. #4814 keep the scroll position when switching versions 4. #4815 pull actions next to the title, with a sticky bar Merge them in order. Each one also contains the commits of the ones before it, until those are merged.

title.text: web/pulls: use the markdown editor and rework the comment form
